title: A merge patch object replaces a sequence document and its keys are plain
notes: RFC 7396 treats a target that is not an object as an empty object, so the result is the mapping `{n: 1}`. Under the core schema `n` is a string, so the new key needs no quotes (docs/edit-semantics.md: a plain scalar is quoted only when it would read back as another type). The key is plain by the kit convention that edits judge plainness by the core schema.

provenance.reference: Differential testing of the oneyaml-python native and pure backends; the native backend wrote `'n': 1`, quoting a key that reads back as a string.
